description: Patch one calendar row (only pass fields you intend to change).

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

post_type.description: Channel + format for schedule, e.g. YouTube short, YouTube video, LinkedIn feed, LinkedIn short (video), Instagram reel, X post. Used when scheduling the row.

publisher_pid.description: Project id from list_projects or create_project. Required: an account-scoped publisher key has no project of its own, so a call without it is rejected.

name: update_calendar_row
